scripts-descriptions.dev: Run the Hello World pipeline in dev mode — writes a semantic log to var/log/<timestamp>.json without Xdebug/XHProf profiling.
scripts-descriptions.profile: Run the Hello World pipeline with semantic profiling — writes a semantic log to var/log/<timestamp>.json (uncompressed Xdebug trace + xhprof enabled).
scripts-descriptions.stree: Render the latest var/log/*.json as a compact tree.
scripts-descriptions.stree:full: Render the latest var/log/*.json as a semantic full tree with full props and close.profile details.
